tiers.name: Purple Surge Fundamentals
tiers.teachingFocus: Teach that Surge clears its landing row and gravity can immediately create the winning four.

tiers.name: One-Move Recognition
tiers.teachingFocus: Recognize ordinary horizontal, vertical and diagonal finishes; Surge is sometimes a decoy.

tiers.name: Surge Setup & Reveal
tiers.teachingFocus: Use the row wipe deliberately to reveal, drop or align a winning connection.

tiers.name: Forced Wins in Two
tiers.teachingFocus: Create a threat the opponent must answer, then finish on the next move.

tiers.name: Defend Then Convert
tiers.teachingFocus: Block an immediate loss or Surge threat, while preserving a winning continuation.

tiers.name: Opponent Surge Awareness
tiers.teachingFocus: Account for the opponent's available Surge and choose lines that remain safe.

tiers.name: Surge Combinations
tiers.teachingFocus: Use Surge as the first part of a combination rather than only as the final move.

tiers.name: Forced Wins in Three
tiers.teachingFocus: Plan two moves ahead through specified forced replies.

tiers.name: Advanced Counter-Surge
tiers.teachingFocus: Exploit or neutralize the opponent's Surge while building a forced finish.

tiers.name: Master Challenges
tiers.teachingFocus: Mixed tactical test: identify whether to win now, defend, Surge, or construct a short forced sequence.

puzzles.title: Puzzle 1
puzzles.teachingFocus: Teach that Surge clears its landing row and gravity can immediately create the winning four.
puzzles.state: Player turn • Player Surge YES • Opponent Surge NO
puzzles.solution: Play PURPLE SURGE in C3. The landing row clears, gravity settles the coins above it, and the vertical four falls into place.
puzzles.hint: No ordinary drop wins here. Ask which row you want gone, then look straight down the columns above it.
